Nathan, saw Topia launched Horizon, the agentic AI platform for global mobility.

A new platform launch usually means more in-market mobility and HR buyers than the team can personally cover, and that is where deals go cold before a rep reaches out. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Topia off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nathan, quick follow-up for Topia.

With Horizon live, the question is usually how many meetings the team needs to convert the demand the launch is creating. Most teams find out late, and by then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Topia needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nathan, last bit of proof for Topia.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Topia's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Nathan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a launch, timing is everything, and I know the post-launch stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Topia either way.
